config_version.markdownDescription: (default: `1`) Managed automatically. Do not change this version.

update_checker.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Requires a server restart to start a new update check.

lang.markdownDescription: (default: `en`) Language file name used for ItemsAdder commands, messages, and GUIs.

config_files.markdownDescription: Language and config loading options. `lang` controls plugin messages, while `dictionaries-lang` controls ItemsAdder dictionary text. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/languages)

max_speed_mib_per_second.markdownDescription: (default: `30`) Per download, in MiB/s (1024 x 1024 bytes). Must be greater than zero.

require_minecraft_headers.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Checks Minecraft HTTP headers; does not authenticate the client.

max_requests.markdownDescription: (default: `10`) Requests per IP, shared by all players behind that address.

after_rejections.markdownDescription: (default: `5`) Rejected requests before a temporary block; requests during the block do not extend it.

protection.markdownDescription: Shared by self_host and simple_self_host. Provider protection overrides take precedence.

pack_hosting.markdownDescription: Reload with /iareload. External hosting still requires publishing the ZIP. none, simple_self_host, self_host, external_host, lobfile, auto_external_legacy To use LobFile, set method: lobfile. Its API key remains in secret.yml.

quality_percent.markdownDescription: (default: `100`) 1-100. 100 uses the encoder default bitrate; it is not lossless.

font_images.markdownDescription: Combine small font images into sheets to reduce client pack loading CPU. Vanilla item glyphs use the server's Minecraft version, downloaded once from Mojang and cached. Disable if another resource pack must override the individual font textures.

force_fix_models.markdownDescription: Usually unnecessary. Fallback for models not found by automatic detection. List vanilla material names (e.g. paper), not model file paths.

models.markdownDescription: Opt-in: merge compatible external item definitions for supported 1.21.4+ clients. IA uses its assigned integer CMDs; external rules remain active for other values. Conflicting/unsupported definitions are left at their existing precedence with a warning.

use_block_material_in_inventory.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Uses vanilla block items for REAL, REAL_NOTE and REAL_TRANSPARENT. Existing PAPER items are converted when accessed; disabling does not reverse conversion.

custom_block_sounds.markdownDescription: Generates the pack patch and enables its matching server-side sound handling.

font.markdownDescription: Set to false to disable font replacement without affecting font images.

scoreboard.markdownDescription: Shader fallback for old clients; requires /iazip and the updated pack.

enable_font_images_with_force_unicode.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Allows font images to work when Force Unicode Font is enabled in the client.

custom_model_data_starting_value.markdownDescription: Starting CustomModelData value for newly assigned item IDs; cached IDs are unchanged. ALL is the default for every material; material names such as DIAMOND override it.

content_conversion.markdownDescription: Converts content configuration files. Disabling does not undo prior conversions.

resource_pack.markdownDescription: Changes require /iazip and the updated pack on players' clients.

delivery_mode.markdownDescription: (default: `per_client_version`) universal or per_client_version. Uses the existing universal ZIP.

sound_packs.markdownDescription: Global override: false ignores all content pack_settings.sound_packs rules. Regenerate with /iazip after changing this setting.

per_client_version.markdownDescription: Families follow ItemsAdder overlay boundaries. Created lazily; false uses universal. Unknown clients and hosting without derived-file publication also use universal.

delay_ticks.markdownDescription: (default: `1`) Used when applying the pack after joining.

auto_apply.markdownDescription: Controls automatic application both before and after joining.

lock_using_entity.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Immobilizes the player using a client entity and hides them from other players.

protect_player.markdownDescription: Attacks by and against protected players are always blocked while loading.

pack_delivery.markdownDescription: Reload with /iareload; changes apply to subsequent pack requests.

registry_changes.markdownDescription: Server settings below use /iareload unless otherwise noted. rejoin, kick, none

worlds.markdownDescription: Enable this block type in resource_pack.custom_blocks.entity.

unregistered_blockstates.markdownDescription: Handles blockstates reserved for custom blocks but missing an ItemsAdder registration. restore_vanilla, register_as_custom, none

fix_reverted_custom_blockstates.markdownDescription: Restores the expected blockstate of already registered custom blocks.

blocks.markdownDescription: Global custom block conversion, placement, liquid, palette and compatibility settings.

fix_trades_guis_match_custom_items.markdownDescription: Makes trade and GUI item matching aware of ItemsAdder custom item metadata.

kick_on_quickbar_spam.markdownDescription: Kicks players who spam quickbar or hotbar item interactions above the configured threshold.

optimizations.markdownDescription: Performance and anti-spam settings for custom item interactions.

enabled.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Enable automatic updating for every custom item unless disabled in that item configuration.

fix_unstackable_items_on_click.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Force merge clicked custom items that share the same namespace and id even when display data differs.

auto_update.markdownDescription: Globally controls automatic updates for custom items already present in inventories or the world. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/items-updater)

migrate_legacy_v3_durability.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Converts durability data from legacy ItemsAdder v3 items.

items.markdownDescription: Global item behavior settings, including updater and legacy item conversion options.

liquids.markdownDescription: Global feature toggle for ItemsAdder custom liquids.

force_color.markdownDescription: Forces a global text color for ItemsAdder HUD rendering.

huds.markdownDescription: Global HUD feature settings. HUDs can also display ItemsAdder custom player stats.

bossbar.markdownDescription: BossBar renderer settings for ItemsAdder cooldown bars.

loots.markdownDescription: Global loot behavior settings for ItemsAdder custom drops.

advanced_enchantments.markdownDescription: AdvancedEnchantments compatibility for enchantments used by ItemsAdder custom items.

compatibility.markdownDescription: Compatibility toggles for external plugins and legacy integrations.

cache_font_images_and_effects_replacemen.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Automatically disabled when InteractiveChat is installed.

chat.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement and suggestions in chat.

excluded.markdownDescription: Commands where ItemsAdder font image replacement is disabled.

command.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement in commands and command blocks.

customitem_name_and_lore.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement in custom item names and lore.

sign.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement on signs.

book.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement in books.

anvil.markdownDescription: Controls font image replacement in anvil rename text.

font_images.markdownDescription: Global support settings for ItemsAdder font images, glyphs, emojis, GUI glyphs and related placeholders. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/adding-content/font-images)

chat.markdownDescription: Enables ItemsAdder text effects in chat messages. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/plugin-usage/plugin-configuration/text-effects-1.17+)

customitem_name_and_lore.markdownDescription: Enables ItemsAdder text effects in custom item names and lore.

sign.markdownDescription: Enables ItemsAdder text effects on signs.

book.markdownDescription: Enables ItemsAdder text effects in books.

anvil.markdownDescription: Enables ItemsAdder text effects in anvil rename text.

text_effects.markdownDescription: Runtime channels reload with /iareload; enabling their resource_pack shader requires /iazip.

delay_packets.markdownDescription: (default: `false`) Reduces packet traffic but may make animations less smooth.

custom_entities.markdownDescription: Runtime settings reload with /iareload; enabling their resource_pack content requires /iazip.

furniture.markdownDescription: Global settings for ItemsAdder furniture entities and furniture placement behavior.

entities.markdownDescription: Global limits and compatibility options for ItemsAdder custom entities, furniture and vehicles. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/adding-content/entities)

avg_seconds_per_stage.markdownDescription: (default: `240`) Default average seconds for a crop to grow by one stage under optimal conditions.

max_crops_in_area.markdownDescription: (default: `1000`) Maximum custom crops allowed in the configured area to limit performance cost.

area_limit_blocks_radius.markdownDescription: (default: `32`) Radius used by the crop area limit.

continuous_harvesting_assistance.markdownDescription: (default: `true`) Helps consecutive crop harvesting while holding the attack button.

interaction.markdownDescription: Improves selection of custom crop hitboxes over nearby vanilla blocks.

billboard.markdownDescription: Billboard rendering uses simpler far-away crop models for better client performance.

checkerboard_pattern.markdownDescription: Checkerboard rendering options for custom crops, used to reduce visual repetition and improve crop visibility.

rendering.markdownDescription: Performance-related rendering options for custom crops.

crops.markdownDescription: Global defaults for custom crop growth and rendering. Custom crops require ItemsAdder 4.0.15+ and Minecraft 1.21.4+. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/adding-content/crops)

crafting.markdownDescription: Enable or disable ItemsAdder crafting table recipes.

cooking.markdownDescription: Enable or disable ItemsAdder furnace, smoker, campfire and blasting recipes.

anvil.markdownDescription: Enable or disable ItemsAdder anvil recipes.

smithing.markdownDescription: Enable or disable ItemsAdder smithing recipes.

recipes.markdownDescription: Global recipe system settings for crafting, cooking, anvil, smithing, recipe book unlocks and vanilla recipe removal. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/adding-content/recipes)

player_stats.markdownDescription: Custom player stats added by ItemsAdder. They can be read by commands, PlaceholderAPI, and HUDs. [Docs](https://itemsadder.devs.beer/other/custom-player-stats)

logging.markdownDescription: Master switch for the configurable diagnostic messages below. Reload with /iareload. Disabling a group preserves its nested preferences.
